sources.title: In boost to Musk, Justice Department seeks to dismiss air pollution lawsuit against xAI data center
supported_record: Associated Press reported that DOJ sought to intervene and dismiss the lawsuit.
Associated Press reported that DOJ framed the data center as critical to the economy and the U.S. military and invoked national security, energy independence, and innovation.
Associated Press reported the NAACP's Clean Air Act allegations and the opposing positions of Mississippi officials, environmental counsel, and xAI or SpaceX representatives.
limitations: The receipt proves the AP report and quoted public positions, not the truth of every underlying allegation.
The complete DOJ motion, declarations, exhibits, docket history, and court ruling remain required.
The article page did not expose a reliable publication date in the retrieved metadata, so the date remains unfilled pending verification.
sources.notes: Use to establish reported DOJ intervention posture and the national-security/economic framing. Do not use as a substitute for the filed motion or as proof of Clean Air Act liability.
